image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a wet, rocky substrate. The subject displays the characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a textured girdle. The anterior end is visible at the bottom left, appearing blunt. A small snail shell is visible in the upper background.
